limitations: One-hour dissolved oxygen at one station using finalized retrospective source measurements; no historical as-of-origin availability, real-time forecast, calibrated prediction interval, pollutant attribution or field benefit established

Exploratory intervals conditional on selected windows and assumed dependence; sensitivity checks are not independent confirmations; multiple criteria do not establish joint 95% coverage or ecological utility
No observed seasonal point-MAE loss is not a proof of statistical noninferiority in every season

The rule is defined from past history; count and errors are reported. An empty seasonal flat subgroup has null metrics and supports no subgroup claim. One or more cases alone do not establish subgroup statistical adequacy
Finalized retrospective USGS records do not establish historical as-of-origin availability or prospective forecast skill
Local file and Git hashes establish reproducibility and integrity relative to the saved archive, not independently authenticated physical truth or a trusted external timestamp
One station and four selected 28-day windows do not validate pollutant attribution, interventions, ecological utility or community outcomes
mission: Verifiable environmental predictions in support of community and youth decision rights; no change to operational Oracle, governance, quorum, treasury, token or spending
